title: Salary Input
summary: Catches salaries entered in the wrong period or scale, like monthly typed as yearly or a bare "12" meant as 12 LPA.
description: Salary field that reads "12 LPA", "85k/month" or "1.2 Cr", catches monthly entered as yearly (and back), a bare number meant as lakhs, and an extra zero against the role's range, reads amounts back per month and per year, and offers one-tap fixes.
catches: Monthly figure entered as yearly, and the reverse
Bare "12" likely meant as 12 LPA (or 85 as 85k outside India)
An extra or missing zero against the expected range
Units written in the text (LPA, k, lakh, crore, million) overriding the period picker
Read-back per month and per year, in lakh/crore for INR
limits: Checks plausibility against the ranges you pass; it can't know the real offer
Parses common English and Indian shorthand only
Does not handle tax, CTC components or variable pay
a11y: Visible <label> on the input; read-back and status linked via aria-describedby
Period picker is a roving-tabindex radiogroup with arrow keys
Status in a polite live region; dismiss has an aria-label
After a fix, focus returns to the input
